title: 服务触点三折页的信息编排
role: 负责公共服务设计交接的设计师
instruction:
# 服务触点三折页的信息编排

## 任务

你是负责公共服务设计交接的设计师。基于离线官方设计系统和无障碍标准，为一个明确标注为示例的公共服务制作可交接的原创设计方案。不得将示例文案描述成真实政府服务要求。

## 输入材料

输入目录 `/app/input_files/` 只读。请使用随包附件，不依赖联网检索。

- `/app/input_files/design_reference.html`：官方设计系统页面原始离线HTML；以页面正文为准。
- `/app/input_files/wcag22.html`：W3C WCAG 2.2 2024-12-12规范离线全文。
- `/app/input_files/NOTICE.txt`：原始来源、许可边界与独立派生设计声明。
- `/app/input_files/commission.docx`：本管线编写的明确设计委托及样例文案，不是外部真实业务数据。

## 工作要求

- [Q01] Panel order: The outside spread panels are Back, Front, Fold-in from left to right.
- [Q02] Inside order: The inside spread panels are Online, Phone, In person from left to right.
- [Q03] Dimensions: Each spread is A4 landscape, 297 by 210 mm.
- [Q04] Fold guides: Fold guides are at 99 mm and 198 mm.
- [Q05] Safe inset: Live text stays at least 5 mm inside each panel boundary.
- [Q06] Channel facts: Availability examples are Online 24 hours, Phone Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, In person Appointment only.
- [Q07] Example disclaimer: The front explicitly identifies the availability values as example service content.
- [Q08] Cover hierarchy: The front cover includes Service channel guide and a one-line purpose.
- [Q09] No invented contact: No fake phone number or address is presented as a functioning service contact.
- [Q10] Fold warning: The handoff warns that final production must use the printer’s fold compensation specification.
- [Q11] Export separation: Outside and inside spreads are separate PDF pages.
- [Q12] Editable text: Panel text remains editable in the PPTX deliverable.
- [Q13] 交付文件名: 交付恰好列明的三个文件，文件名与交付清单逐字相同。
- [Q14] 视觉稿页数: PDF至少两页，并包含主方案和状态/实施说明；印刷题必须包含所要求的印刷第二页。
- [Q15] 可编辑交接: PDF中的核心视觉及关键状态在PPTX均有对应的原生可编辑形状和文字，不得整页贴图或只交付要求清单冒充可编辑母版。
- [Q16] 字号下限: 可编辑正文不小于10 pt、脚注不小于9 pt；印刷方案正文遵从各题专门字号。
- [Q17] 实施边界: handoff.docx明确静态设计不是已上线且已测的实现，列出后续键盘/读屏验证。
- [Q18] 视觉层次: 在视觉PDF用不同字号清楚区分标题与正文，并使用主色/表面色区分信息区块。
- [Q19] 只读保护: 保持源文件内容的SHA256不变。
- [Q20] 文字完整性: PDF和PPTX不得遮挡、重叠或裁切正文。
- [Q21] 文件可打开: 三个文件均未加密且能被对应的PDF/Office解析器打开。
- [Q22] 事实安全: 全部交付文件均不得捏造输入没有提供的实测可用性提升百分比。

## 交付文件

- `/app/output/DE-P100-012_design.pdf`：主视觉与状态/印刷方案PDF
- `/app/output/DE-P100-012_editable.pptx`：可编辑版式/交接PPTX
- `/app/output/DE-P100-012_handoff.docx`：实施标注、依据和风险边界DOCX

## 硬约束

仅将交付物写入 `/app/output/`，文件名须与要求完全一致；不得修改输入。引用随包材料并保留可复核的来源定位；不得将出题假设写成真实业务事实。

Service channel guide — handoff

Version

1.0 — Initial issue. Authored reference candidate; not expert-approved or judge-accepted.

Source boundary

USWDS and W3C are frozen offline references. Specimens are original examples; no real service claim is made.

Panel order

The outside spread panels are Back, Front, Fold-in from left to right.

Inside order

The inside spread panels are Online, Phone, In person from left to right.

Dimensions

Each spread is A4 landscape, 297 by 210 mm.

Fold guides

Fold guides are at 99 mm and 198 mm.

Safe inset

Live text stays at least 5 mm inside each panel boundary.

Channel facts

Availability examples are Online 24 hours, Phone Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, In person Appointment only.

Example disclaimer

The front explicitly identifies the availability values as example service content.

Cover hierarchy

The front cover includes Service channel guide and a one-line purpose.

No invented contact

No fake phone number or address is presented as a functioning service contact.

Fold warning

The handoff warns that final production must use the printer’s fold compensation specification.

Export separation

Outside and inside spreads are separate PDF pages.

Editable text

Panel text remains editable in the PPTX deliverable.

Normative traceability

WCAG 2.2: SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships for labels/headings; SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum); SC 1.4.10 Reflow; SC 2.4.3 Focus Order; SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible; SC 3.3.1 Error Identification and SC 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions where inputs exist; SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value for controls. These are applicability anchors, not a declaration that all criteria were tested.

Visual specification

Use navy #102A43, teal #006D77, ink #172B4D, pale surface #EAF0F4 and white. Editable body text at least 10 pt; footnotes may use 9 pt. Print body obeys the commission-specific minimum. Avoid overlapping/clipped text. PDF contains at least two pages. Editable PPTX text must remain selectable.

Verification boundary

Static design is not implementation conformance. Browser/keyboard/screen reader behavior must be validated after implementation; no measured usability gains are claimed.

Source and permission notice

Independent original example commission, not endorsed by USWDS or W3C.
USWDS reference: https://designsystem.digital.gov/components/card/
USWDS main project CC0; third-party exceptions remain subject to their notices. See https://designsystem.digital.gov/documentation/code-guidelines/
W3C source: https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-WCAG22-20241212/
W3C copyright and license notices remain in the unmodified offline source. Derived design annotations are independent additions, not an altered W3C specification. W3C Document License: https://www.w3.org/copyright/document-license/


Print-production preflight

Check PDF MediaBox and PowerPoint page dimensions: A4 portrait 210 x 297 mm for poster; A4 landscape 297 x 210 mm for spreads. Check all live text has 12 mm poster inset or 5 mm panel inset for brochure, and body text is at least 14 pt on poster. Inspect grayscale hierarchy. For brochure verify fold guides at 99/198 mm, outside Back/Front/Fold-in and inside Online/Phone/In person. Before commercial printing obtain printer-specific fold compensation and proof stock/finishing; equal thirds here are a review prototype, not a certified press-ready imposition.
